title: rvt-diff --elements --json
description: The comparison rvt-diff --elements A B --json PATH writes (rvt::ifc::element_diff::ElementDiff, #1843): the elements the IFC export of each file writes, keyed by the GlobalId it writes, as added, removed, changed (with the fields that differ) or unchanged; an unchanged element whose label properties alone differ (the rule that read a value, not the value) is also listed in relabelled. The fields are what the export writes, not the Revit file's records, so a change rvt-rs does not read is not seen. An element whose GlobalId either export writes for more than one element is not compared: it is in none of the four lists, and duplicate_global_ids and set_aside say which and how many, so that left_elements = removed + changed + unchanged + set_aside.left and right_elements = added + changed + unchanged + set_aside.right.

left_elements.description: The elements the first file's export writes.

right_elements.description: The elements the second file's export writes.

added.description: In the second export only, by GlobalId.

removed.description: In the first export only, by GlobalId.

changed.description: In both, with a field that differs, by GlobalId.

unchanged.description: In both, with every field equal but label properties.

duplicate_global_ids.description: The GlobalIds each export writes for more than one element, sorted. Two elements under one key cannot be told apart, so their elements are set aside.

left.description: Written more than once by the first export.

right.description: Written more than once by the second export.

set_aside.description: The elements of each export left out of the comparison because their GlobalId is in duplicate_global_ids (of either export).

relabelled.description: Of the unchanged, those whose label properties differ (LevelBindSource, and BodySource where the body is equal), by GlobalId: the rule that read a value changed and the value did not (#1864).

element.description: One element as the export writes it (rvt::ifc::element_diff::ElementState).

global_id.description: The GlobalId the IFC export writes.

ifc_type.description: The IFC entity, such as IFCBEAM.

storey.description: The name of the storey the export puts it on.

type_name.description: The name of the type object the export writes for it.

location_feet.description: Where its body is placed, model feet.

body.description: A digest of the body (its extrusion, solid and mapped geometry): equal digests are equal bodies.

properties.description: Each property the export writes, keyed <set>.<property>, as {kind, value}.

change.description: An element both exports write, with the fields that differ (rvt::ifc::element_diff::ElementChange).

field.description: A field of the element, or property:<set>.<property>.

left.description: Its value in the first export, null where it had none.

right.description: Its value in the second export, null where it has none.

labels.description: The label properties that differ, which are not changes (#1864).

left.description: Its value in the first export, null where it had none.

right.description: Its value in the second export, null where it has none.

relabel.description: An unchanged element whose label properties differ (rvt::ifc::element_diff::ElementChange with no changes).

left.description: Its value in the first export, null where it had none.

right.description: Its value in the second export, null where it has none.
